editorial_approval.basis: Owner authorized unattended daily execution after accepting The Open Door strategy and controlled creative testing.
editorial_approval.context_review: The complete Surah is used. The framing preserves its full answer to human loss: belief, good work, mutual truth, and mutual endurance. It does not reduce the passage to productivity advice.
editorial_approval.test_variable: Short direct challenge about time and busyness versus Episode 4's relationship-centered provocative claim.

source.exact_translation: By time— humankind is deep in loss, except those who believe, do good, urge one another to truth, and urge one another to endurance.
